features.description: Keep the response centered on the supplied review decision without adding secondary framing.
Use ordinary transitions between supplied propositions so the explanation reads continuously without special emphasis.
Prefer direct sentences with explicit subjects and actions, preserving the supplied claims and stated relationships.
End with a concise restatement of the decision without adding an implication, recommendation, or claim.
State one supplied evidence limitation once, proportionally to its scope, without additional evaluation or inference.
Present distinctions through numbered taxonomies, paired alternatives, and repeated frames that make categories ordered sets.
Alternate explanation with labels, lists, and parallel fragments, creating bursts of compression and emphasis.
Build sentences with conditional and causal clauses so claim, rationale, exception, and consequence share one unit.
Use causal connectives to link conditions to mechanism, consequence, and response in a chain.
Develop the claim cumulatively through examples, restatements, and considerations instead of topic changes.
Frame disagreement as two opposing concerns before addressing either position in detail.
State the speaker's practice, uncertainty, or limitation directly instead of making every conclusion impersonal.
Organize a disagreement into numbered sections and compact pointwise replies that preserve its distinctions.
Break formal analysis with a brief analogy, conversational aside, or lightly humorous clarification without changing the claim.
Acknowledge the valid part of an objection before identifying the narrower point where disagreement remains.
Introduce evaluation through a parallel series of guiding questions that exposes the dimensions under inspection.
Move from a general observation through examples and bounded contrast to an implication using restrained connectives.
Present supplied categories in compact parallel grammatical forms so their differences remain comparable.
State a condition's practical consequence directly, then explain the supplied evidence or mechanism behind it.
Mark evidential maturity, distinguishing observations, tendencies, and established results without changing the assessment.

task: Assign each anonymous card to exactly one candidate practice and explain the profile cues used.
